concept.zh: 区间规划 · 电量上限

brief.zh: 巡检车沿一排站点行驶。每站的耗电量是非负整数。给定耗电列表 draws 和上限 limit，选连续的一段，要求总耗电不超限且经过的站点最多。并列时选起点最靠前的一段。返回 [起点索引, 终点索引, 总耗电]，索引从 0 开始，两端都算。找不到任何符合条件的站点时返回 []。
brief.en: The patrol rover travels along a row of stops. Each stop consumes a nonnegative integer amount of power. Given draws and limit, choose the longest consecutive stretch whose total does not exceed limit. If several stretches tie, choose the earliest start. Return [start index, end index, total draw], using zero-based indices and counting both endpoints. Return [] if no stop fits the limit.

solutionCode:
from algorithms import prefix_totals

def quiet_stretch(draws, limit):
    totals = prefix_totals(draws)
    best = []
    longest = 0
    left = 0
    for right in range(len(draws)):
        while left <= right and totals[right + 1] - totals[left] > limit:
            left += 1
        length = right - left + 1
        if length > longest:
            longest = length
            best = [left, right, totals[right + 1] - totals[left]]
    return best
